rationale: Round 4 shows firmer position-locking rather than convergence: labour and Lower Saxony now insist on a binding no-closure, no-forced-redundancy frame, while management, owners, and investors continue to hold closures and stronger structural measures as necessary if the numbers do not work. The only apparent progress is agreement to commission site-by-site economics, so the discussion is circling around process without resolving the core conflict.
